[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip 'assembly fixtures cover amd64 and arm64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd a/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/asma$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' holds assembly files'
stderr 'example\.com/amain/cmd'
stderr '-> example\.com/adep'
stderr 'transitive_unsafe_allowlist'
! stderr 'unauthorized_unsafe'
cd ../..

cd b/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/asmb$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/asmb$GOEXE
stdout '^granted$'
cd ../..

cd c/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/asmc$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr '\[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\].*example\.com/cdep'
exec $WORK/bin/asmc$GOEXE
stdout '^warned$'
cd ../..

cd d/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/asmd$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/asmd$GOEXE
stdout '^allowed$'
cd ../..

cd e/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/asme$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/asme$GOEXE
stdout '^std-asm-ok$'
cd ../..

cd f/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/asmf$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fdep'' holds assembly files'
cd ../..

cd g/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/asmg$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unclassified_assembly\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/gdep'' holds assembly files'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/adep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(adep.Zero()) }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/stub.go --
package adep

func Zero() int

-- a/dep/stub_amd64.s --
#include "textflag.h"

TEXT ·Zero(SB), NOSPLIT, $0-8
	MOVQ $0, ret+0(FP)
	RET

-- a/dep/stub_arm64.s --
#include "textflag.h"

TEXT ·Zero(SB), NOSPLIT, $0-8
	MOVD $0, R0
	MOVD R0, ret+0(FP)
	RET

transitive_unsafe = "deny"

package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/edep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(edep.Sum()) }

-- e/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/edep

go 1.27

-- e/dep/dep.go --
package edep

import (
	"bytes"
	"math/big"
)

func Sum() string {
	var z big.Int
	z.Add(big.NewInt(1), big.NewInt(2))
	if bytes.Equal([]byte("a"), []byte("a")) && z.Int64() == 3 {
		return "std-asm-ok"
	}
	return "bad"
}
